title: Ordinary singleton extension commutes with geometric inverse image
statement: For sites small relative to the module universe, coefficient-ring towers with pulled-back transitions, and specified algebraic inverse images, construct exact termwise inverse image of strict semilinear systems. Ordinary singleton extension commutes with this functor. The level comparison is the scalar extension comparison, normalized on all generalized tensor generators; above the selected index the comparison is zero; at the selected index it is normalized by multiplication. The full precise statement is the attached Lean declaration.

proof.text: Construct each pulled-back semilinear transition by conjugating its underlying set-sheaf map with the recorded inverse-image comparisons. The operation diagrams for addition and scalar action make it linear; the coefficient graph equation supplies the scalar compatibility. Conjugation proves identities, composition and naturality. The exactness theorem applies at every coefficient level, and the componentwise universal properties of strict limits and colimits prove exactness of the termwise system functor.

proof.text: Apply the normalized balanced coefficient-square construction with identity structural maps on X. Strip the two identity scalar extensions using their normalized tensor units. Conjugate by the scalar models’ recorded object-equality isomorphisms. The inverse generator formula gives the ordinary coefficient-change comparison and its unit equation. Transporting scalar multiplication extends that equation to every generalized tensor generator.

proof.text: Take the mate of the strict evaluation square under the two ordinary singleton adjunctions. Below the selected level, transpose its evaluated component and use the coefficient comparison’s unit equation to identify it with the inverse tensor comparison and the two below-level isomorphisms. Above that level both objects are zero. Thus the mate is invertible; its inverse is the specified ordinary singleton comparison. Its unit equation gives multiplication normalization.

theorem geometricSystemOrdinaryComparison
    (BY : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (BX : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf K CommRingCat.{w})
    (u : GeometricMorphism (Sheaf K (Type w)) (Sheaf J (Type w)))
    (I : ∀ n : ℕ, AlgebraicInverseImage u.inverse (BY.obj (op n)) (BX.obj (op n)))
    (htransition : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
      u.inverse.map ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{w})).map
          (BY.map (homOfLE h).op)) ≫ (I m).ringUnderlying.hom =
        (I n).ringUnderlying.hom ≫
          (sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{w})).map
            (BX.map (homOfLE h).op))
    (SY : SystemScalarAssignment (J := J)) (TY : SystemTensorCoherence SY)
    (SX : SystemScalarAssignment (J := K)) (TX : SystemTensorCoherence SX) :
    ∃ F : GeometricSystemOrdinaryData BY BX u I,
  ∃ (ordinary : ∀ n : ℕ,
      systemSingleFunctor SY TY BY n ⋙ F.functor ≅
        F.levelInverseImage n ⋙ systemSingleFunctor SX TX BX n)
    (tensor : ∀ {j n : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n),
      systemTensor SY BY h ⋙ F.levelInverseImage j ≅
        F.levelInverseImage n ⋙ systemTensor SX BX h),
    (∀ {j n : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) (P : systemLevel BY n),
    (F.evaluation j).hom.app ((systemSingleFunctor SY TY BY n).obj P) ≫
        (F.levelInverseImage j).map ((systemSingleBelow SY TY BY n h).hom.app P) ≫
        (tensor h).hom.app P =
      ((ordinary n).hom.app P).app j ≫
        (systemSingleBelow SX TX BX n h).hom.app ((F.levelInverseImage n).obj P)) ∧
    (∀ {j n : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) (P : systemLevel BY n)
    (Z : Sheaf J (Type w))
    (b : Z ⟶ (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{w})).obj (BY.obj (op j)))
    (x : Z ⟶ (geometricSystemUnderlying BY n).obj P)
    (z : Z ⟶ (geometricSystemUnderlying BY j).obj ((systemTensor SY BY h).obj P)),
    (∀ U t, z.hom.app U t =
      systemModelTmul (SY (BY.map (homOfLE h).op)).model P U
        (b.hom.app U t) (x.hom.app U t)) →
    ∀ (W : Dᵒᵖ) (t : (u.inverse.obj Z).obj.obj W),
      ((tensor h).hom.app P).val.app W
          (((u.inverse.map z) ≫
            (I j).moduleUnderlying.inv.app ((systemTensor SY BY h).obj P)).hom.app W t) =
        systemModelTmul (SX (BX.map (homOfLE h).op)).model
          ((F.levelInverseImage n).obj P) W
          (((u.inverse.map b) ≫ (I j).ringUnderlying.hom).hom.app W t)
          (((u.inverse.map x) ≫ (I n).moduleUnderlying.inv.app P).hom.app W t)) ∧
    (∀ (n j : ℕ) (h : n < j) (P : systemLevel BY n),
    ((ordinary n).hom.app P).app j = 0) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (P : systemLevel BY n),
    ((ordinary n).hom.app P).app n ≫
        ((systemSingleBelow SX TX BX n (Nat.le_refl n) ≪≫ TX.ordinaryUnit BX n)).hom.app
          ((F.levelInverseImage n).obj P) =
      (F.evaluation n).hom.app ((systemSingleFunctor SY TY BY n).obj P) ≫
        (F.levelInverseImage n).map
          ((systemSingleBelow SY TY BY n (Nat.le_refl n) ≪≫
            TY.ordinaryUnit BY n).hom.app P))
